\"不起眼的死神，是它们留给世人的称谓。蜘蛛在各个阴暗角落里筑巢，在黑暗中等待猎: " 'Little gods of death' they are called by those who fear and know them intimately. The arachnid makes its nest inside the blanched skulls of dead men, waiting in darkness to poison the world."
\"可怕的捕食者。抛弃那些幼稚的想要拥抱这些美丽野兽的想法，因为它们是强大和暴力: "Man-eaters. Predators. Cast aside the childish notion of embracing these beautiful beasts, for they are mighty and violent. They will tear into shreds all who approach them without respect."
\"可怜那个发现自己被追捕的人，他无处可躲，无处可逃，无处不在的犬吠声如影随形。: "Pity the man who finds himself hunted. There is no place he can hide, nowhere he can run to, for a maddened barking will follow, and the canine will always sniff him out."
\"噩梦的触手从虚空中探出来，散发出无尽的爱与恨意。他们无情的拥抱和吸吮，把一切: "Nightmares sprung forth from the tentacular void. An eldritch hatred emanates from various appendages, and the suctioning grip of their callous embrace will pull a man further into unholy depths."
\"在这些灵长类动物的眼睛后面，有一种智慧，能吸引你。但这里没有同情心，没有仁慈: "There is an intelligence behind the eyes of these primates, a sentience that draws you in. But there is no empathy there. No kindness. Only hatred and anger, a lust to maim and kill."
\"外表是蓬松的毛发和慵懒的肌肉，但它们不止捕猎猎物，更捕猎猎手。熊从洞穴中爬出: "Shaggy mounds of muscle and hair, not just man-eaters, but eaters of man-eaters. The Ursae venture out from their dens, lumbering through wooded land, grizzly and starving for hot blood and sweet flesh."
\"带着各种奇怪的造型，这些聚集在黑暗中的家伙注定要永远折磨这个已知的世界。他们: "Wandering proboscises and clicking mandibles, the swarming masses birthed from darkness destined to forever plague the known world. They bring poverty and painful poisons, those who devour the harvest."
\"曾经，他们的祖先统治着这个世界。但是，由于人类的打扰，他们冰冷的血液沸腾了，: "Once, their ancestors ruled this world. But dethroned by the arrogance of man, their cold blood boils over and their forked tongues flick in and out, tasting the air. They will take their pound of flesh, and bring misery upon any who try to stop them."
\"有人说这种甲壳动物是由死去的人的灵魂所生，来自那些战斗后倒下的战士。因为它们: "Some say the crustacean is born from the souls of dead men, those warriors who fought and fell, for the crab is formed with its armour intact: its sword becomes its pincers and its shield becomes its skin."
\"这些令人憎恶的东西本不该存在。每个人看到他们的时候，灵魂就会颤抖，周围的空气: "The abominations have no right to exist. When a man sees them, his spirit shakes, and the air around him pops and cracks, as if the universe itself is angry within this unnatural presence."
\"这些栖息于泥巴和沼泽中的生物，散发出恶臭的同时又具有不可思议的才能，在水上和: "A creature of mud and swamp, the amphibian is a foul smelling thing. Beware his uncanny talent to breathe both above and below, for with this trick, he will lure his prey and let it sink into the deathly grip of a murky mire."
\"远古的人们看着它们，认为它们是神，因为只有神才能在如此的高空飞翔。这是鸟类传: "The ancients looked upon them and thought them gods, for only the gods could ascend to such lofty heights. 在默认情况下，只有特定的[DamageTypes|伤害类型]才能计入特定的[Ai:
By default, specific [Ailments] are calculated based on only specific [DamageTypes|damage types], such as only the [Fire] damage of a [HitDamage|Hit] mattering when inflicting [Ignite].

Allowing another damage type to contribute to an [Ailments|Ailment] means that all damage of the relevant types is summed when performing calculations for that [Ailments|Ailment].

For [Ailments] that use [HitDamage|Hit] damage to determine [Ailments|Ailment] chance or buildup, this means that the damage type becomes capable of inflicting that [Ailments|Ailment]. For [Ailments] that only use [HitDamage|Hit] damage to determine [Ailments|Ailment] [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] (i.e. [Bleeding] and [Poison]), you still need a way to apply those [Ailments] (e.g. a source of [Bleeding] or [Poison] chance).

Maps containing a Delirium Mirror can have the mirror walked through to unleash the rolling Delirium fog ring across the current area. 
You must stay within this fog as it expands to maintain the [Delirious|Delirium] or it will disappear.

[Rarity|Magic] monsters are able to gain Delirium specific [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] while inside the fog.

[Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique] monsters in the fog may manifest Delirium Demons. Manifested Delirium Demons inhabit the monster's body to occasionally use Skills of their own.

[FracturingMirror|Fractured Mirrors] may be found within Delirium Fog, summoning extra monsters while [FracturingMirrorShard|Fracturing Mirror Shards] are found at set depths, with more varied rewards.

Defeating [MapBoss|Map Bosses] has a chance to summon a [DeliriumGigaMirror|Grand Mirror] on a nearby map.

[Fire] damage from [HitDamage|Hits] [Contributes] to the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability, so [HitDamage|Hits] that deal more [Fire] damage will [Ignite] more often.

The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability is 1% chance to Ignite the target for every 5% of the target's [AilmentThreshold|Ailment Threshold] dealt as [Fire] damage. Flammability from a [HitDamage|Hit] is applied before that hit checks whether it should [Ignite] the target, and so will affect that chance for that [HitDamage|Hit] to [Ignite].

Since chance for [HitDamage|Hits] to [Ignite] comes from Flammability on the target, modifiers which increase the chance to inflict [Ailments] will increase the [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Flammability inflicted.

Effects which do not [HitDamage|Hit] targets, but [Ignite] as if they had, such as [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground], also inflict Flammability, but do not roll a random chance to [Ignite]. Such effects will only [Ignite] once the total Flammability on the target reaches 50%.

Multiple instances of Flammability stack, raising the chance for [HitDamage|Hits] to [Ignite] the target up to 100%. Each instance of Flammability has its own independent duration, lasting 8 seconds by default.

The base [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of Ignite is [Fire] damage per second equal to 20% of the [Fire] damage dealt by the [HitDamage|Hit] that inflicted it. This is calculated using the final damage dealt by the [HitDamage|Hit], but not any modifiers on the target that affect how much damage they will take from the [HitDamage|Hit]. This [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] is not further affected by any modifiers to the damage you deal.

Modifiers and [Debuff|Debuffs] that affect the enemy's ability to mitigate damage (such as [Shock]) can affect the damage the enemy takes from Ignite, but any such modifiers that specifically apply to [HitDamage|Hit] damage (such as [Penetration]) do not affect Ignite damage.

猛击地面，对周围造成大量伤害，并留下[JaggedGround|崎岖之地]减速敌: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] that slows enemies. The [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] erupts in a powerful [Aftershock] after a duration. Cannot create [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.
猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. 猛击是造成伤害性范围效果的[Melee|近战][Attack|攻击]，而非直接用: Slams are [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] that cause damaging areas of effect, rather than [Strike|Striking] enemies with your weapon directly. Damage from Slams is still [Melee] damage.

献祭最多半叠命运卡，相同命运卡的数量可能为0，也可能翻倍: Sacrifice up to half a stack of Divination Cards to receive between 0 and twice that amount of the same Card

[CopperCitadel|Copper Citadels] in Faridun Cities, [IronCitadel|Iron Citadels] in Ezomyte Cities and [StoneCitadel|Stone Citadels] in Vaal Cities.

Verisium Remnants allow you to craft a variety of rewards. Each Remnant has a number of slots available for runes to be inscribed, and when you first find it, it will have one rune already inscribed.

The number of monster waves are one less than the total number of inscribable slots for the chosen recipe. Each wave of the encounter will activate an additional runic effect, starting from the first two runes on the left.

By default, chance-based stats cap at 100% chance for the result to occur. However, some chances can surpass 100%. In this case, the event for which you have a chance to effect will occur once for each 100% chance for that event you have, and then have a normal percentage chance for it to occur again based on the remaining value.

For example, a Surpassing 215% chance for an event to occur will cause the event to occur twice (once for each 100% chance) and have a 15% chance for it to occur a third time.
